name: Diabetic Consistent-Carbohydrate Diet
description: Keeps carbohydrate steady across meals and limits added sugar, sugary drinks, and sodium. Example limits for learning; confirm with a registered dietitian.

rules.message: Each day should include breakfast, lunch, and dinner so carbohydrate is spread out.
Carbohydrate in one main meal must not go over 60 g.
Carbohydrate in one main meal should be at least 45 g.
Carbohydrate in one snack must not go over 30 g.
Carbohydrate should be similar across main meals (within 15 g of each other).
Added sugar must give less than 10% of the day's calories.
rules.source: WHO guideline: Sugars intake for adults and children (2015) - free sugars below 10% of energy

rules.message: Sugar-sweetened drinks are not allowed on this diet.
Dietary fiber for the day should be at least 25 g.
Sodium for the day should stay at or below 2,300 mg.
rules.source: ADA Standards of Care - less than 2,300 mg sodium per day

rules.message: Saturated fat should give less than 10% of the day's calories.
rules.source: WHO guideline: Saturated fatty acid and trans-fatty acid intake (2023)
